minor.issue: FIXED — the 'Unassigned' bucket was returned even when total=0, violating the spec that said it should only appear when it has data. Changed the filter in analytics_by_location from `if b['total']==0 and key is not None: continue` to `if b['total']==0: continue`. Verified by test_phase3.TestLocationAnalytics.test_filter_and_by_location.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 605 LOC — route modules for actions/notes/digest should be split out into submodules before more surface area is added.

run_weekly_digest sets `started_at` BEFORE finishing. If a worker crashes mid-run, the row is left orphaned (no `finished_at`) and the dedupe check still skips subsequent runs with the same run_id. Consider a status field + TTL fallback, or move the dedupe `insert` to after success.

auto_action titles are built from AI summary; the `response_id+source=auto` uniqueness relies on an application-level find_one rather than a unique index (there IS an index on (response_id, source) but it's NOT unique). Under high concurrency two reanalyze calls could both pass the find_one and create duplicates. Low risk here (single-worker + background tasks) but worth hardening with a unique partial index.

The reanalyze path always re-runs AI even when the stored sentiment hasn't changed, so the auto-action guard is doing double duty — fine, but means repeated calls will cost LLM tokens with no new effect. Consider skipping when ai.analyzed_at is < 1 minute old.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (nav-actions, templates-bg, kanban board create/claim/move/delete, analytics location filter + breakdown, response team notes CRUD all verified via Playwright against prod URL)

seed_data_creation: Re-ran `python /app/backend/seed.py --fresh` to clear earlier test pollution before testing. Submitted one extra TEST negative public response during tests which produced an auto action (confirmed) — ensure next agent re-seeds if clean state matters.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_phase3.py — run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in env and `-o addopts=` to disable xdist. It requires MONGO_URL + DB_NAME + WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET from /app/backend/.env (loaded via dotenv). The cron test waits up to ~10s for background task; the negative-sentiment test waits up to 25s for the LLM. If RESEND_API_KEY stays empty the digest_sends rows will have sent=False — that's correct per the problem brief. The server.py now contains a small fix on the by-location analytics unassigned-bucket filter.
rca of the issue: GET /api/analytics/by-location was including the Unassigned (location_id=null) bucket even when it contained zero responses. The brief explicitly required Unassigned to appear only when it has data. The condition `if b['total']==0 and key is not None: continue` whitelisted the null key, so the empty-list case still emitted an Unassigned row with total:0, average:0, sentiment:{0,0,0}. Reproduction: with the demo seed (all 8 responses assigned to locations), GET /api/analytics/by-location returned 3 rows (2 locations + Unassigned with total=0). Mitigation applied in server.py: drop the `and key is not None` so any zero-total bucket is hidden. Verified by test_phase3.TestLocationAnalytics.
